summary: Groundwork so Nora's after-the-turn review cannot argue with her own turn. The notes she actually opened while replying are now carried through to the review, which will use them to avoid raising a question the turn already looked at and set aside.
details: The set was already being kept — it is what stops her writing over a note she has not read — but nothing outside that check could see it, so the review had no way to know what the turn had already considered.
It is handed over as a copy. The review runs after the reply, and letting a later step change what the earlier check relies on would undo the protection it provides.
limitations: Nothing consumes it yet: the review still cannot raise notes at all, because the store cannot yet accept a brand-new one. This is the wiring, landed separately so it stops being a gap now rather than whenever that arrives.
If the set cannot be read for any reason it is treated as empty, which refuses nothing — the worst case is a duplicate suggestion, never a lost review.
